notes: Text sizes, line heights, letter spacing, spacing, shadows and the default transition timing are Tailwind v4 defaults that Extend consumes implicitly; they are read from the pinned tailwindcss theme.css rather than from globals.css.
--alpha(color / n%) is resolved as color-mix(in oklab, color n%, transparent). All Extend uses are black/white, where the sRGB and oklab results agree, so the resolved value is exact for this file.
color-mix(in srgb, ...) is resolved by mixing sRGB channels; color-mix(in oklab, ...) is flagged approximate.

fonts.monoFallback: "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
fonts.note: apps/v4/lib/fonts.ts loads Geist/Geist Mono through next/font and assigns --font-sans / --font-mono; the harness uses the same families from @fontsource-variable.

spacing.note: Extend components use calc(--spacing(n) - 1px) for the 1px inset border, e.g. button px-[calc(--spacing(3)-1px)] = 11px.

focusRing.note: Select trigger uses focus-visible:ring-[3px] instead of 2px (see mapping.ringWidth).
